name: afferent-concept-regen
about: Assets from art/plan.json that must change to match design/concept.md (Layers of Light). Valid plan for art/generate.py: style, isolated, suffixes and assets are read by it. Always pass --only; draft first (--draft writes art/raw/draft/), then finals with --force because the names already exist. task_assets is not read by the generator: it is the hand-off for the minigame workflow that owns art/tasks_plan.json. no_generation lists assets handled by copy or vector export; never pass their names to --only.

order: figure_walk figure_ride figure_crouch figure_sit (one Keeper, check all four side by side)
workflow.promote: cp art/raw/concept/concept_final_start.png art/raw/bg_start.png; cp art/raw/concept/concept_final_end.png art/raw/bg_end_dawn.png; cp art/raw/concept/concept_final_patient.png art/raw/bg_patient.png
workflow.icon: Rasterise design/concept/final/concept_final_icon.svg to art/raw/app_icon.png at 1024 (headless Chrome screenshot of the SVG at 1024x1024).
acceptance: silhouette reads as a 32 px black shape
greyscale value read holds (light tops, mid bodies, darker bases)
no warm pixel except where the prompt names it; no light painted into transparent assets
visible ply lines on every landform edge
no grain, no brush texture, no 3D or plush look
Keeper: round dome hood, no point, no scarf, no staff, no face
at most one retry per asset

style: Calm flat 2D illustration for a wordless Finnish mobile game, in the spirit of 1930s Finnish functionalist design: free-form wave curves and bent laminated birch plywood (inspiration only, no real buildings, furniture or products). Every landform, shoreline, snowdrift, fell and path is one long, smooth, asymmetric free-form curve drawn in a single unhurried gesture: no zigzags, no jagged edges, no hard corners. Every landform is laminated: along its curved top edge run two to four thin parallel offset lines in pale birch tones that follow the curve exactly, like the cut edge of bent birch plywood. Shapes are large, flat and matte like smooth painted plaster, each with at most one very soft smooth tonal gradient. Any sky is a perfectly smooth continuous gradient: no banding, no stripes, no scanlines, no noise, no speckle, no grain. No outlines, no brush texture, no paper grain, no 3D render look, no glossy or plastic highlights, no clay or plush look, no photorealism. Strong clear silhouettes, very few elements. Palette: deep fjord #0E1A2E, kaamos blue #1E3150, frost #9DB9CC, lilac haze #B4A6CE, birch white #F2EEE6, birch ply #E2C79C, ply edge #B48E5C, sun yellow #F2C230, honey #FFD58A, dawn apricot #F3A57A, ice #8FC6E0, spring green #9DBE8C, spruce #2F4A48, granite #8A8F9C, ceiling green #C8D6BE. Warm light is sun yellow and honey only, never orange-red, never pink, never coral, never red. Quiet, hopeful, gentle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no faces.
isolated: Isolated element on a fully transparent background, orthographic side view. Paint it in its natural local colours at middle value under soft even overcast daylight: no cast shadows, no light sources, no glow, no night or sunset tint, muted slightly desaturated colours (never neon or lime), because the game adds darkness, light and colour grading in code. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no sky, no backdrop, no frame, no vignette, no border, no extra buildings, islands or water.
backdrop: Full-bleed portrait illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, lighting painted in, a big calm empty sky, a small figure in a large world, no frame, no border, no vignette.

suffixes.plate: Full-bleed portrait illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, lighting painted in, a big calm empty sky, a small figure in a large world, no frame, no border, no vignette.
suffixes.sky: Isolated sky element on a fully transparent background, orthographic side view. It carries its own light and colour exactly as described, soft and smooth, never neon. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no land, no water, no trees, no horizon, no backdrop, no frame, no vignette, no border.
suffixes.additive: Flat pure black #000000 background filling the whole frame, for additive blending in code: every pixel that is not part of the light itself is exactly black. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no land, no water, no trees, no horizon, no stars, no frame, no vignette, no border.

keeper: The Keeper, the only character: a small, round, child-sized figure about half as wide as it is tall, in a felted wool cloak the colour of birch plywood #E2C79C with a soft kaamos-blue #1E3150 shadow side; a smooth dome-shaped hood that is perfectly round on top (no point, no tip, no ears, no pompom, no fur trim) flowing straight into a cloak that flares gently into a bell shape down to the ground; a hem band of two thin darker ply lines #B48E5C near the bottom of the cloak; no scarf, no staff, no pole. Seen exactly from the side facing right with the hood opening turned away, so no face is ever visible. One small mitten holds a small round lantern on a short handle at hip height, lantern glass dark and unlit.

assets.name: far_mountains
assets.prompt: A long low range of smooth rounded Nordic fells far away drawn as one continuous wave line, flat frost #9DB9CC bodies with pale birch-white snow caps, two thin pale ply lines following the crest, flat bottom edge, occupying only the lower third of the image. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: v3 gouache with brush texture; the concept needs flat plaster shapes with laminated crests.
assets.use: Unchanged placement (L2 far, tile at hy, group blue).

It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.

assets.use: Unchanged (L2b, group blue). The village of lanterns still sits on this band.

assets.name: sky_dawn_clouds
assets.prompt: Three or four very thin, flat, long horizontal streaks of stratus cloud loosely across the middle of the image, each only 2 to 5 percent of the image height and many times longer than tall, smooth flat shapes with softly tapered ends, undersides honey #FFD58A and dawn apricot #F3A57A, thin lilac haze #B4A6CE upper edges, the gaps between streaks fully transparent. No puffy cumulus, no brush strokes. The streaks run off both image borders at the same heights.
assets.why: Old undersides were coral #F49D6E (close to red) and dry-brushed.

assets.name: sky_aurora
assets.prompt: Only the northern lights: a wide, sheer aurora curtain built from many fine, evenly spaced, thin parallel vertical lines that bend together in one long, slow free-form wave across the full image width, like a curtain of thin bent birch veneer strips lit from behind; brightest just above its soft lower hem, fading upward into black with no top edge, colour aurora green #5FE3A1 at the hem fading to ice #8FC6E0 at the tips. Dim, delicate, see-through, never a solid ribbon or blob. Upper 55 percent only; the lower part is pure black.
assets.why: The laminated-veneer aurora is the concept's signature sky element.

assets.name: mid_hills_spruce
assets.prompt: Gently rolling snowy hills drawn as one continuous wave line with two to three thin ply lines along the crest, a loose band of simple flat spruce silhouettes in spruce #2F4A48 of varied heights (each spruce a soft tapered shape, not jagged), birch-white snow between them, lower half of the image. It is one long horizontal strip that runs off both the left and right image borders without ending; both ends are cut straight by the border at the same height, so copies tile side by side.
assets.why: Jagged painted spruce band; needs flat tapered shapes and laminated crest.

assets.name: mid_birch_grove
assets.prompt: A loose, irregular row of seven slender birches spread across the full width with uneven gaps, two close together, one leaning slightly, heights varying at random, never symmetric. Flat birch-white #F2EEE6 trunks with short dark rounded lenticel dashes, fine bare twig crowns as thin flat lines, a few small birch-ply golden leaves at twig tips. Every trunk ends on one flat base line near the bottom edge with a small snow mound whose top shows two thin ply lines.
assets.why: Gouache texture; flat language and ply mounds.

assets.name: birch_cluster
assets.prompt: A cluster of three slender birches, one leaning, flat birch-white trunks with short dark rounded lenticel dashes, fine bare twig crowns as thin flat lines, a small snow mound at the base whose curved top shows two thin ply lines, full image height.

assets.name: sauna_hut
assets.prompt: A small Finnish log sauna hut in flat matte shapes, warm wood logs in two flat tones, thick smooth snow on the roof whose curved front edge shows two thin ply lines, a short stone chimney, one small square window that is dark and unlit, a tiny porch with a bench, standing on a smooth snow mound with a laminated edge.

assets.name: lighthouse
assets.prompt: A slender, gently tapering birch-white day-mark tower with no stripes and no bands, a small round lamp room with dark unlit glass and a thin birch-ply cap, a small flat balcony ring, standing on a smooth rounded granite #8A8F9C base whose top edge shows two thin ply lines, full image height. assets.name: pier_boat
assets.prompt: Strict side elevation at eye level. A short wooden pier on round posts in two flat grey-brown tones, the plank edge as a thin horizontal band with two thin ply lines and a little snow on top, and a small rowing boat in exact profile moored at its right end, hull birch ply #E2C79C with a thin ply edge #B48E5C line along the gunwale (no coloured stripe). Pier posts and the boat bottom end on one straight horizontal line; no water drawn.

assets.name: boathouse
assets.prompt: A small Finnish boathouse with a gabled roof under thick smooth snow whose edge shows two thin ply lines, walls in muted ochre birch ply #E2C79C deepened to ply edge #B48E5C at the base, white trim, wide dark doors facing the water, standing on smooth granite. Flat matte shapes.

assets.name: lantern_post

assets.prompt: Kaamos late at night, very calm and dim. Portrait composition. Sky a smooth gradient from deep fjord #0E1A2E at the top to kaamos blue #1E3150 at the horizon, a thin crescent moon behind veiled cloud, a few tiny soft stars. Low brightness, no bright areas, the only warm pixels are the ember and the far lights. The Keeper, the only character: a small, round, child-sized figure about half as wide as it is tall, in a felted wool cloak the colour of birch plywood #E2C79C with a soft kaamos-blue #1E3150 shadow side; a smooth dome-shaped hood that is perfectly round on top (no point, no tip, no ears, no pompom, no fur trim) flowing straight into a cloak that flares gently into a bell shape down to the ground; a hem band of two thin darker ply lines #B48E5C near the bottom of the cloak; no scarf, no staff, no pole.
